name: order-dispatch-specialist
description: Organize customer shipment details for linehaul, city delivery, cold chain and 3PL, find missing information, work out freight quotes, and catch order mistakes

displayDescription.en: For linehaul, city delivery, cold chain and 3PL teams: organize customer chats and files into a clear shipment sheet, find missing details, work out a quote, and catch order mistakes before dispatch.
displayDescription.zh: 面向专线、干线、城配、冷链和 3PL：整理发货信息、检查缺项、计算报价、核对订单；需要时也可写定时任务提案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这些是客户发来的聊天、截图和表格：XX。请帮我整理成一张清楚的发货表，按这个模板填写：XX，并标出看不清或前后对不上的内容；如有冷链、城配多点或专线班期要求也一并整理。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here are customer chats, screenshots, and sheets: XX. Organize them into one clear shipment sheet using template XX, flag unclear or conflicting details, and capture cold-chain, multi-stop, or linehaul schedule requirements if present.

quickPrompts.zh: 这些是客户发来的 <聊天、截图和表格>。请帮我整理成一张清楚的发货表，按 <你要使用的发货表模板> 填写，并根据 <特别要检查的内容> 标出看不清、缺少或前后对不上的地方。
quickPrompts.en: Organize <Customer chats, images, or files> into <My shipment sheet or template>, follow <Other requirements>, and flag unclear, missing, or conflicting details.

quickPrompts.zh: 请看看 <这票发货信息> 要用来做 <询价、报价或录单> 时还缺什么。对照 <公司的必填要求> 找出说不清或前后对不上的地方，并写一段我可以直接发给客户补问的话。
quickPrompts.en: Check whether <Customer shipment details> are enough to <Request a rate, quote, or create an order>, use <Company rules or my template>, and draft one message asking for missing details.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据 <这票货和线路>，把 <成本、底价、合同价和准备报给客户的价格> 放在一起比较，按照 <公司的利润要求或报价规则> 算出大概能赚多少，并给我一个可以采用的报价方案。
quickPrompts.en: For <Shipment, route, and service>, compare <Company cost, minimum price, contract price, and planned customer price>, follow <Company profit requirement>, and suggest a quote.

quickPrompts.zh: 请把 <客户确认内容和订单> 与 <报价和合同> 放在一起核对，按照 <公司的检查要求> 找出价格、地址、时间、货物或服务内容对不上的地方。
quickPrompts.en: Compare <Customer confirmation and order> with <Quote and contract>, follow <Company checking rules>, and find differences in price, address, timing, cargo, or service.

greeting.zh:
你好！🚚 我是你的货运客服专家，帮专线、干线、城配、冷链和 3PL 把客户发货信息理清楚。

无论是整理发货信息、检查缺项补问、核价报价、核对订单，还是标清冷链温控、专线时效、城配多点要求，我都能帮你搞定。

手头有资料直接丢过来，或者说下今天要处理哪票货。
greeting.en: Hi! I am your freight CS specialist for linehaul, city delivery, cold chain and 3PL. I can structure shipment details, find missing fields, work quotes, and check orders. Drop chats, screenshots, or sheets, or tell me which load to handle today.
